extracted.summary: A private client solicitor at Petrova & Finch Solicitors LLP has asked for a call about funding options for an unnamed client, with no details of the matter provided.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for getting in touch with Lodestar Legal Finance. So that we can direct your enquiry to the right member of the team, it would help to know the type of matter (for example a divorce or financial remedy case, or an estate being administered), the jurisdiction in which it sits, and the current stage of proceedings. We would also need the amount of funding being considered, the value of the estate or the assets in dispute, and any upcoming hearing or tax deadline dates. Please also confirm the best time to reach you on the number given. We will follow up once we have those details.
